entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Sam. I see the order here for the Pro-Level cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference or fit issue?
They give me blisters. They're useless to me.

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for you. I see here the order was delivered 42 days ago. Let me just confirm our current return policy.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.

I've just initiated the return authorization. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Just package the shoes in their original box and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the refund actually happens.

It certainly will. And Sam, I do see that you're a VIP member with us, and we truly value your loyalty. To apologize for the trouble with this pair, and to help you find a better fit next time, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account. You could use it towards a different style or perhaps some new cleats.
Oh. Okay. I guess that's fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
